verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT GPU can be self-hosted locally with ROCm supporting PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, and Llama.cpp on Windows/Linux, enabling a full local AI stack as an alternative to cloud solutions. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of self-hosted setup working smoothly on consumer RDNA4 hardware (ROCm support for consumer cards has historically lagged datacenter cards), and no evidence of a dedicated self-hosting quickstart/deployment guide.
